title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-and-reporting-pipeline-v117
author: Eleanor Ng
description: Adds a new set of performance test suites (v117) to Benchmark Lab and wires them into the reporting pipeline and persistent baselines. Motivation: capture representative conversational and high-throughput workloads for the latest serving runtime kernel changes (ENG-6523), make baselines reproducible in CI, and surface nightly reporting to the telemetry S3 bucket and the reporting dashboard. This PR includes new suite definitions, profiling baseline artifacts, a lightweight ETL to ingest results into the reporting table, and a CI workflow to run playback tests. Checklist: - [x] Add conversational and high-throughput YAML suites - [x] Produce profiling baseline (v117) JSON artifacts - [x] Implement reporting ETL and add sample S3 manifest - [x] Add CI workflow to run benchmark playback nightly and on-demand - [x] Add docs and runbook with troubleshooting steps - [x] Address flaky test failures observed in local runs Notes: the description contains end-to-end design decisions; replayable artifacts are stored under benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v117.json and the reporting pipeline is intentionally idempotent to allow reruns. Related: ENG-6523 (runtime kernel selection), ENG-6580 (adaptive batching experiments).
commits: add: conversational and high-throughput suite definitions
feat: add profiling baselines v117 (generated) and baseline metadata
chore: reporting ETL to ingest bench results into reporting table and S3 manifest generation
ci: add benchmark-playback workflow and playback runner wrapper
fix: flaky telemetry test by increasing timeouts and adding retry backoff
docs: benchmark-lab overview and runbook updates
review_comments: Kai Zhou: Overall looks good — couple of nits on naming and a request to add a short TTL on S3 manifests to avoid orphaned manifests.
Eleanor Ng (author): Added s3_manifest.ttl config and default to 7 days. PTAL.
Maya Patel: Can we make the playback job run with a reduced token budget by default in CI to keep costs down? Also request to add a failure alarm in reporting ETL when ingestion fails 3x.
Eleanor Ng (author): Updated CI playback to use --budget=1000 tokens and added a rerun counter + alert metric in ingest_results.py. Logs are emitted to telemetry::benchmark.playback.
Jordan Lee: Integration tests were failing locally due to a race in the playback runner; suggested using an exponential backoff for the readiness probe.
Eleanor Ng (author): Implemented backoff and added comment explaining the race. CI run passed after re-run.
Kai Zhou: Approved (squash) — verified nightly job and saw results land in S3 and reporting table.
merge_details: Squashed and merged by Kai Zhou after CI green; commit message summarizes suites, baselines, and reporting ETL. Nightly job scheduled under ci/workflows/benchmark-playback.yml.
release_notes: Added Benchmark Lab v117 performance suites (conversational, high-throughput), profiling baselines v117, reporting ETL to ingest results into reporting table and S3, and a CI playback workflow. Improves baseline reproducibility and enables nightly reporting for regression detection.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps baseline artifacts checked in for traceability. Future work: move baseline generation to an automated nightly artifact builder and add an alerts -> runbook link in the reporting dashboard.
